description: Create a Google OAuth app (consent screen + Web client) in Google Cloud console with Playwriter, for "Sign in with Google" in a product (better-auth, Google login). Covers the Google Auth Platform pages (Branding, Audience, Clients, Data Access), publishing to "In production" with External user type, and storing GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in Sigillo without printing the secret. Load when asked to create Google OAuth credentials, a Google client id, or to publish a Google consent screen.
